system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Geometric figure with parallel lines and triangle]

In this figure, line l is parallel to line m. The measure of angle DAC is 55°.
What is the value of x + y?

Figure, described in words:
Two horizontal parallel lines are shown: line l on top and line m on the bottom. Points A and D lie on line l, with D to the right of A. Points B and C lie on line m, with C to the right of B. Line segments AB and AC connect the two lines, forming triangle ABC. A dashed arc indicates that angle DAC measures 55°. Inside triangle ABC, angle BAC at vertex A is marked with an arc labeled x°, and angle ABC at vertex B is marked with a dashed arc labeled y°.

A. 55
B. 110
C. 125
D. 135

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer
